description: This file contains unit tests for the LDAPSyncService's method deleteLocalUsersWhoRemovedFromLDAPServer, verifying that it correctly deletes or marks delete users based on LDAP entries. It tests various scenarios including normal deletion, duplication handling, and failed LDAP fetches.

classes.name: LDAPSyncServiceDeleteUsersTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing deletion of users who are removed from LDAP by LDAPSyncService.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the fixture directory path for test data.

methods.name: testDeleteLocalUsersWhoRemovedFromLDAPServer
methods.description: Tests that users no longer present in LDAP are marked as deleted in the local database.

methods.name: testDeleteLocalUsersWhoRemovedFromLDAPServerWithDuplicateUserNames
methods.description: Tests deletion behavior when LDAP entries contain duplicate user names.

methods.name: testDeleteLocalUsersWhoRemovedFromLDAPServerWithFailedUsers
methods.description: Tests behavior when some LDAP entries lack required attributes, simulating failed user fetches.

methods.name: getEntryCollection
methods.description: Mocks an EntryCollection object with provided LDAP entries and lookup setting.

methods.name: getLDAPEntries
methods.description: Creates mock LDAP entries for specified users.

methods.name: getLDAPEntriesWithDuplicateUserNames
methods.description: Creates LDAP entries with duplicate user names for testing duplicate handling.

methods.name: getLDAPEntriesWithFailedUsers
methods.description: Creates LDAP entries with missing attributes to simulate fetch failures.
